name: visor-buscador
description: Buscador y Visor de Documentos Tecnicos

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w backend
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.bench:search: npm run build:shared && npm run bench:search -w backend --
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:demo -w backend --
scripts.docs:purge-errors: npm run build:shared && npm run docs:purge-errors -w backend --
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @kata/shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w backend
scripts.test:cov: npm run build:shared && npm run test:cov -w @kata/shared && npm run test:cov -w backend && npm run test:cov -w frontend
